productTabs.descriptionIntro: The Ergopod Feeding Pillow- Lucky Clover is designed to make every feed calmer, closer, and more comfortable for you and your baby.

descriptionItems.title: Ergonomic Wrap-Around Design:
descriptionItems.body: Ergopod Feeding Pillow- Lucky Clover wraps fully around your waist to provide a secure fit. The curved front supports your baby's torso while the wings hug your sides, so you don't need to hunch or keep repositioning.

descriptionItems.title: Built-In Lumbar Support:
descriptionItems.body: A structured lumbar panel sits at the lower back to encourage neutral spine alignment. You'll feel gentle, even pressure that discourages slouching during long feeds or cluster feeding.

descriptionItems.title: Adjustable Velcro Strap for a Custom Fit:
descriptionItems.body: The wide velcro strap of the Ergopod Feeding Pillow- Lucky Clover lets you adjust the size to you in seconds, even one-handed.

descriptionItems.title: Waterproof Lining:
descriptionItems.body: The waterproof upper lining blocks spills from soaking into the fabric, stopping stains and damp patches from setting in. It also helps curb odour build-up, keeping the cover feeling fresher for longer between washes.
